item.title: Muroki Returns Home with Amber Skies
item.description: One of Aotearoa’s most distinctive young voices, Muroki returns home with his long-awaited debut album Amber Skies, out 30 January 2026. Written and recorded while living nomadically between Berlin, Raglan, Portugal and Kenya, Amber Skies captures Muroki’s drive for freedom, new experiences and connection. item.title: Lily Allen (UK) performing West End Girl this October 2026
item.description: Lily Allen is back. The iconic UK pop star brings her first New Zealand show in over seven years to Auckland this October. Lily Allen performs West End Girl in full, front to back… her most personal release yet. Lily Allen has always done pop her own way, saying the quiet parts out loud and soundtracking a whole generation with Alright, Still and It’s Not Me, It’s You.
